senses.gloss: forward, in front, on, forth (mostly in connection with a verb, esp. with a verb of motion which is often to be supplied; sometimes repeated before the verb, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 6; rarely as a separate word, e.g. AitBr. ii, 40)
as a prefix to subst. = forth, away, cf. प्र-वृत्ति, प्र-स्थान
as pref. to adj. = excessively, very, much, cf. प्र-चण्ड, प्र-मत्त
in nouns of relationship = great- cf. प्र-पितामह, प्र-पौत्र
(according to native lexicographers it may be used in the senses of गति, आ-रम्भ, उत्-कर्ष, सर्वतो-भाव, प्राथम्य, ख्याति, उत्-पत्ति, व्य्-अवहार), RV.; &c.
प्र [cf. पुरस्, पुरा, पूर्व; Zd. fra; Gk. πρό; Lat. pro; Slav. pra-, pro-; Lith. pra-; Goth. faúr, faúra; Germ. vor; Eng. fore.]
2. प्र mfn. (√ पॄ or प्रा) filling, fulfilling
(n. fulfilment ifc.; cf. आकूति-, कक्ष्य-, काम-)

1. प्रा cl. 2. P. (Dhātup. xxiv, 53) प्राति (pf. P. पप्रौ॑ or पप्रा, 2. sg. पप्राथ, p. पप्रिव॑स् f. ˚प्रु॑षी, RV.; Ā. पप्रे, 2. sg. ˚प्रिषे, ib.; AV.; पप्रे as Pass., Bhaṭṭ. aor. 3. sg. अप्रात् or अप्रास्, RV.; Subj. प्रा॑स् or प्रा॑सि, ib.; aor. Pass. अप्रायि, AV.), to fill, RV.; AV.; Br.; Bhaṭṭ.
2. प्रा mfn. filling (ifc. = 2. प्र; cf. अन्तरिक्ष-, काम-, क्रतु- &c.)

3. प्रा Vṛddhi or lengthened form of 1. प्र in comp. (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 122). Observe in the following derivatives, only the second member of the simple compound from which they come is given in the parentheses, leaving the preposition प्र (lengthened to प्रा in the derivatives) to be supplied.
